name: Absenteeism
overview: Scripture calls believers to faithful and wholehearted service in all things, doing everything as if serving the Lord rather than men. The principle of treating others as we wish to be treated underscores the responsibility to be present and diligent. Faithfulness in small matters reflects faithfulness in greater ones, highlighting the importance of consistent attendance and commitment in all areas of life. Ultimately, every action should be done in the name of Jesus, with gratitude to God, demonstrating sincere devotion and reliability.
